10111010.t:
It suddenly got dark?
What did she do?

...I sense a strong Corrupting Power.
I don't know the exact principle behind it, but... this place has been forcibly 'overwritten' by her power.
Overwritten?

Yes.
She overwrote 'this' world with 'that' one.
Setting aside whether a copy-paste like that is even possible... what happens to us now?

I don't know for sure either.
However... at this rate, everyone will be 'overwritten' in the exact same way.

Gradually, little by little, we will grow to resemble them...
until we become the 'same'.

You mean we'll turn into Aberrant Spirits?
Or that the Aberrant Spirits will become like us?

I don't know... Somewhere in between, perhaps?
I have a feeling that's what will happen.

That is right. Everyone together...
will enjoy a happy Halloween festival...
Forgive me, but this is not a festival meant for the likes of you.

...?
Is that so?

Halloween is the night of the dead...
A festival where the boundary blurs and the forgotten return...
If so, are we Aberrant Spirits not the true hosts of this day...?
...She's got a point, doesn't she?

Hold on, my friend.
What are you doing taking their side right now?

I'm not taking their side, her logic just makes sense.
Right?
What utter nonsense are you spouting...

Stop right there!
Muscle-brains can step back.
M-Muscle-brains...
However, my friend—

You know this isn't something we can solve that way, right?
Just stay put for a second.

Alright...
I get what you're claiming for now.

Do you...?
I knew you would...

Don't get excited just yet.
I said I 'got' your point, not that I 'agreed' with it.
Pardon...?
Alright, let's check one thing.
Are the 'Aberrant Spirits' and the 'dead' you're talking about the same word?

You've been switching between the two words this whole time.
Like they're similar, yet not quite...

If you mix them up like that, nobody's gonna be able to understand, right?
So let's get the definitions straight.

Times like this call for a lifeline to an expert.
Isn't that right, Kouchou?

At the very least, as far as I know...
they are different.

The dead are those who once possessed life and departed to the realm of death.
In other words, those who have experienced both life and death.
However, Aberrant Spirits...

They have experienced neither life nor death.
They merely exist.
Therefore, they are not the dead.

Heh, expected no less of the Shrine Maiden of the Boundary.
To define them so precisely.
...You heard her.

...How surprising.
Indeed, one could define it that way...
That is right... Aberrant Spirits are beings who know neither life nor death, [emptiness] itself... And that is why we yearn and crave...

Then, can you not understand...?
The pain of wishing for what cannot be obtained, of desiring what can never be held in your hands.

We... wanted to let the children have a taste of it.
This day, this festival, this life and light...
Yes... To give the children a taste of that 'revelry' you speak of...
Dan Xi.

I-I know...
I do not know how she figured me out to say such a thing, but she speaks quite amusingly.

It is as if she split my head open and peered inside.
To bring up 'revelry'... to me, of all people.
Anyway, so you agree that you Aberrant Spirits aren't the dead, right?
Which completely debunks your claim that Halloween is your festival.

...Heh, that is true.
It seems I truly cannot beat you with logic...

Of course.
Letting children win is part of an adult's role, after all...
Hey. You keep calling us children every chance you get... I'm not a kid, you know.

If you're gonna back down, just hurry up and leave already.
Stop stalling for time.

That is true...
Just as you say, this festival is not ours...
We are the uninvited, the unwelcome...
And so we deceived the [world]... by wearing the masks of the dead...
...So those outfits weren't just cosplay, huh?
...You catch on quickly, don't you?

This is the power to create a tiny [Rift] between boundaries...
Merely a trifling trick absorbed from a nameless lingering thought in the distant past...

A way to create a peaceful world without splitting or tearing the boundary...
where no one takes or is taken from...
Did you think I would just stand by and watch that happen?

My role is the Shrine Maiden of the Boundary.
The one who watches the boundary and drives away Aberrant Spirits...

Speaking of peace while trying to erode our world... Claiming not to take while seizing our festival.
I cannot tolerate... any of it.

What a pity...
I thought the likes of you would understand us...

Very well, in that case...
let us have a 'match'...
A match?
Yes... Please compete with our children... to see who the true host of this festival is...

If you can convince our children out on the festival streets...
I shall return this festival to you...
After all, that will be far more enjoyable than fighting meaninglessly...
...A match usually has a time limit, though.
She left out all the actually important details, damn it.

...It means the transformation of the people into Aberrant Spirits is already underway.
She's probably trying to stall for time until it's complete.

Of course, it's not as if there's no way out.
I can feel the Corrupting Power gathering at the pavilion... which means the boundary has collapsed around that spot.

If we can purify the Corrupting Power gathered at the pavilion...
we should be able to restore the boundary and bring the festival back to normal.

Except...
The problem is all the Aberrant Spirits blocking our way...

Heh, what is there to worry about?
I shall clear the path. Simply follow my lead!
...There she goes getting all hyped up by herself again.

10111020.t:
How fascinating. Aberrant Spirits enjoying a festival...
Perhaps I should revise my assessment of them a little!
...They're merely mimicking the people enjoying the festival.

It's likely an effect of being overwritten.
No one notices that anything is wrong.

Wait, does that mean...
we're the only ones who can tell something's off?
Yeah. This probably all looks perfectly normal to everyone else.
In fact, they might even see us as enemies for trying to stop the festival...

That's bad news.
Doesn't that mean people like Chise could end up standing in our way?
If that happens...
<:player>, figure something out for us.
You only count on me at times like this!
You won't do it...?

Damn it... Do you really think looking at me with those eyes will get you anywhere?
Well, I guess it will get you somewhere...

A-Anyway, I'm a Fixer, so bring me an official request.
And stop giving me those eyes every time you need something.

By the way, ever since you put on that outfit...
you've been way more expressive, haven't you?
...Perhaps it's the influence of my newfound power.
Well, being honest isn't a bad thing.

Anyway, where did Dan Xi run off to?
She talked like she was gonna wipe out all the Aberrant Spirits, when they're just strolling around enjoying the festival.
Haha! Besides, attacking Aberrant Spirits who are just enjoying the festival wouldn't be like Dan Xi at all!
If anything...

Mmm...♡ Hic!
Were you looking for me, my friend?

Whoa, you barely just ran off and you're already wasted?
Wait, didn't you say you were going to clear a path?

Indeed. I most certainly cleared a path!
...Hic!
I opened the path to revelry and merriment!!
I'm an idiot for thinking I could count on you, even for a second, when you charged out of here.
Wait, more importantly, where and who the heck have you been chugging booze with?

Hmm?
Why, with my newfound friends, of course!
Behold, the new friends I have made!
...Well, this is unexpected.
Well, they do say a valiant general can befriend even their enemies!
Come now, don't be shy! Drink, drink up!
Hmm? Passing out already? What a lightweight you are!
Now then, how well can you hold your liquor?!

Good grief. Is there no one here who can go drink for drink with me?
...Hic!

Well, I doubt there are many people who can keep up with Dan Xi.
Wait, do Aberrant Spirits even get drunk when they drink?
...The effect of being overwritten...?
So you don't really know either.
Now, who is the next person—no, ghost—no, Aberrant Spirit to enjoy the festivities with me?!
...Well, I guess the path is clearing up, at least?
My, oh my! Everyone here is truly dedicated to enjoying the festival!

They're not enjoying it, they're clinging to you.
What are they, remoras?

Come to think of it, my back does feel a bit heavy...
Perhaps I had a bit too much to drink...

My friend, I shall rest my eyes for a moment...
Wake me when fresh drinks arrive...

Still, that's Dan Xi for you.
Most people would struggle to stay sane with even one of those things clinging to them!
Because Dan Xi is special.
More importantly, the path to the pavilion is open.

Hold on, Kouchou.
You're going into the pavilion just like that?

Yes.
I'm going to defeat Shade and seal the Aberrant Spirits away.

Of course!
But you can't do it on your own, Kouchou...
...It's fine. I have <:player> with me.

Huh?
Me?
I'm not afraid of anything anymore.
That's a blatant jinx right there.

Not a chance.
We're taking Dan Xi with us.
...Just the two of us would be fine, though.

Yomi, does the Blissful Trading Guild have anything good for a hangover?
Like a hangover cure or something.

Yes, yes!
Of course we do!
Though hangover cures are more 'Yura's' specialty than mine...

If you need one, I might get scolded a bit later, but...
I can sell it on her behalf, you know? As long as you pay a fair price!

Great. Then give me a hangover cure first, and...
Is there anything we can do about those Aberrant Spirits?
We could handle one or two, but if they swarm us like that, even Dan Xi ends up like this.

Hehe...
Yes, I'll go fetch the hangover cure right away, so please wait just a moment!
And as for the Aberrant Spirits... Hmm, well, there is a way...
What's the problem?
Well, it's the only one in stock, so it's a bit pricey...
...Can't you give me a discount?
Ahaha! I really, really can't do that! It's my masterpiece, and the only one of its kind in the whole world!

Every time you open your mouth, it's another lie.
I bet you can just make another one anyway! 20% off!
Aw, come on! Slashing the price that much is a real insult to my work! 5%!

I'm buying the hangover cure with it, aren't I?
15%!
Well, since you bought Kouchou's outfit earlier, I'll be extra generous... How about 7.5%?

Still too expensive!
12%!

Hehe, take it or leave it!
Believe it or not, we're quite wealthy!
Letting this one gather dust in the warehouse wouldn't bother me in the slightest!

...Huh?
Gather dust in the warehouse?

Didn't you say it was your masterpiece? One of a kind??
Aha... I see, so that's how it is!
...Huh? W-Why are you making that face...
I knew it... You didn't make that to sell it, did you?
You just made it because you felt like it, and now you're stuck with something you can't even get rid of, right??
Ah, ahahaha...

10%! I'll give you a 10% discount!
This is really my final...

There's always another final offer after the final offer!!
50%!!!
Wha... What?! All of a sudden?!!!

10111030.t:
Selling an item at this price... I'm going to be the laughingstock of the guild...
Boohoohoo!

Besides, this piece...
wasn't meant to be sold off like this...

Cut the nonsense.
It was a blatant rip-off from the start, wasn't it?

Th-That's an outrageous misunderstanding?!
It was no rip-off! I only started at such a low price because it's you, Fixer!

Besides, I wove that outfit by hand, stitch by stitch!
You have no idea how much effort I put into making Sealing Implements!
Talking about whether a customer is "qualified" and calling your merchandise a "piece"... I can see right through your routine.
Isn't it obvious you're just trying to pass it off as a luxury item to jack up the price?

Slandering me so heartlessly again...
Boohoo...
Knock off the terrible fake crying already.

More importantly, Dan Xi!
When are you coming out?!

Ugh! I have never tasted anything so bitter in my life.
Though it did sober me up right away...
Hehe, my companions in the guild may all be eccentrics, but their skills are the real deal!
Of course, with Yura's level of skill, she could even make a medicine that keeps you from touching alcohol for a good while!

You remember how wild Dan Xi got at the last festival...
Well, the Chrysanthemum Clan came to us with quite a few requests back then...

Tch, those Chrysanthemum Clan folks...
I only got carried away by the festivities and made a few little mistakes...
I heard the compensation for the shops she wrecked back then cost as much as an entire house!
...Just what on earth did you do??

Ahem! Ahem!
L-Let us move past such trivial matters.
More importantly, this outfit...
Hmm... My friend, is this the sort of thing you fancy?
Had you told me, I would have looked for something like this much sooner...
It's not like that?! Well, if you're asking whether I like it or not, I definitely do, but it's not like I custom-ordered it??
Don't ask me why it looks like that—ask Yomi.

Oh my, it covers everything it needs to cover, doesn't it?
It more than fulfills its purpose as clothing!
After all, it was intended to function primarily as a Sealing Implement!
Haha, fair enough!

And...
Hmm, it is actually much easier to move around in this.
Those talismans have the effect of warding off Corrupting Power trying to invade from the outside!
So even if Lady Dan Xi has a few too many again, at least the Aberrant Spirits won't be able to mess with her head!

Oh, and the weapon was custom-made separately.
It'll be very effective for exorcising Aberrant Spirits!

Oho! By the way...
I haven't seen Sirius for a while now. Does that have something to do with the talismans as well?

Sirius is a spiritual beast, after all!
I've made sure it can only manifest inside Lady Dan Xi's body, where the talismans won't affect it!
I already got its consent, so you can just think of it as taking a little vacation!

How could this be...
Then who is going to draft the budget for the Fairwinds Association?
You were making Sirius do that?!

Well... As you know, revelry and paperwork are worlds apart, are they not?
Sirius is a spirit creature, clever, and has the eyes of a hawk...

Because it IS a hawk!
At this rate, you're gonna have it doing your taxes next, aren't you?
Anyway, I paid good money for that Sealing Implement, so make sure you get my money's worth.

Ah! I-I see.
In this outfit, it is much easier for you to touch me, too...
Well, there was definitely more than one reason I made up my mind to buy it the second I saw it.
...Someone's coming.
You arrived quite quickly...

The children...
are not yet satisfied, however...

There's no need for that.
Because you... will all be sealed away right here.

Hehe, what a naughty child.
Refusing to listen to your elders...

Scolding and disciplining such a child...
is also an adult's duty...

Dan Xi, Yomi. Help me.
If the three of us join forces...

...Did I not tell you before?
That I have no intention of fighting...
If that's true, stop the corruption and return to where you belong.
I cannot do that...
Then I have no choice but to seal you.

If you refuse to listen to reason...
then it cannot be helped...

If that is your wish...
then we have no choice but to take another approach...
Another approach...?
What is this?!

Whoa?!
We're falling...?!
Kouchou, catch <:player>!
Got it, I attached a butterfly to him.

Let me tell you once again...
It is not yet time for all of you to come this far...
Please satisfy my children first, and then come back to see me...

Hey! What the hell does that mean...
Hey!

10111040.t: Mmm... Haa...
U-Ugh... What is this...?
<:player>, are you alright...? What about Dan Xi...?

I-I am fine.
However... I cannot... move...?

Ngh...!
It's burrowing into me... Haa...

Oh my, me too... Mmm!♡
It keeps pressing... against my sensitive spots.

Now what...
Anyway, hold on a sec, I'll turn on some light.

Whoa?!
What the heck is going on with you two...?!
Mmm, something... is pressing against me from behind...!

Ahh...♡
My friend, I cannot move a muscle here... And what is more...

Something... is being drained from me.
Is this like an Aberrant Spirit...?
An immense power... All the Impure Energy gathered from the Halloween festival streets... is filling this place.
Thanks to my power and Dan Xi's talismans, we won't be corrupted right away, but...

At this rate, it is only a matter of time...
Heh, I suppose this is what they call being caught between a rock and a hard place!

Blocked by a transparent wall in front...
and left in this state from behind!

...Yeah, it's definitely a rare sight.
Wait, this isn't dangerous, is it...?
It's a little... troublesome...

At this rate, our strength will be drained...
and in the end, we might be swallowed up by this Impure Energy too...
Oh, Yomi's calling?

Fixer!
Can you hear me??

Yomi!
Where are you?

It's quite difficult to make me fall with curses or spells, after all!
Hehe...
Wait, does that mean you're up there all alone with the Aberrant Spirits...?!

Oh, I have my ways of dealing with that too!
Anyway, I'm going to excuse myself for now!

I can't stay here forever...
and I need to go find my next qualified customer!
Sigh... You're really something else.

Then help us out with one last thing before you go!
Kouchou and Dan Xi are pinned against some weird wall and about to be toyed with by Aberrant Spirits! Is there any way out of this?
Hmm, from what I can sense, all the energy gathered from the festival streets seems to be concentrated right down there!

However, it seems there's still one barrier left holding the Aberrant Spirits back!
That must be what that wall is!

A barrier?
So, like some kind of magical shamanistic wall...
Yes! Anyone without Impure Energy in them should be able to pass through freely, buuut...
But you know the state Lady Kouchou and Lady Dan Xi are in right now, don't you?
Ah... I get it now.
So we just need to purify as much of the Impure Energy inside their bodies as possible... right?
Yep! Pretty much!

Well then...
Whoops, the Aberrant Spirits are starting to swarm in. I'll be off now!
...She really just bailed on us.

Anyway, purification.
If we're talking purification...
Haa... Haa...

Haa... Haha, how laughable.
To think that we, who hunt Aberrant Spirits, are being toyed with by mere Impure Energy like this...

Haa?!
I-It suddenly got stronger!

Ah... It's getting rougher.
It's gotten a 'taste' for us...
A taste...?!
Hehe, are you curious... what we taste like?

Well, I'd be lying if I said I wasn't, but...
let's put that aside for now.
Purification... How to purify them...

...Wait.
Come to think of it, didn't she say a normal person can pass through that wall freely?
H-Huh?
Hup.
<:player> Y-Your hand... went right through the wall, and grabbed my chest...!
Oh... It actually works?

Though I don't think just doing this will purify anything...
Hmm...
Hup!
Nngh?!

Whoops, my bad.
I didn't mean to grab your chest, it just drew my attention way too hard.
Alright, one more time!

!?
M-My friend, what are you...
Hah—!
Haa?!!
Nngh...!?
Well, if I get all those impurities out of you, that counts as purification too, doesn't it?!
Alright, I'm cranking this massage up to max intensity until every last bit of it is out of you!!
S-So recklessly??
C-Consider the situation we're in...!
Hyaaaah!!

10111050.t:
Haa... haa...
M-My legs gave out...
Ugh... It seems we made it through the wall... in more ways than one...

Hey, are you two alive?
You didn't turn into ghosts, did you?
Judging by how your Sealing Implements are restored, it looks like you're fine now...
How... mortifying...
Join... us... and become... one...
...What's with the terrible acting?
Pfft...
Ahahaha!

Sigh... Alright.
As long as you two are having fun.

Thanks to your quick wit, my friend, we were able to escape that place.
I knew I could count on you.
Yes, how did you even come up with a method like that?

Well, I mean...
She said we had to draw out the Impure Energy, right?
And you said that weird mass was draining your strength, didn't you?
That's... true, right?
Which means it's basically like a leech sucking out your energy.

Whether it was Impure Energy or not...
I figured if I gave you a strong enough stimulus to make you release all your energy at once, it'd greedily lap it right up.

Besides, Kouchou specializes in purifying that kind of power...
so I figured if I could get your strength up even for a moment, things would work out somehow.
Oho...
To think you thought that far ahead...

Thank you, my friend.
The two of us never would have come up with such an idea on our own.

Right.
I'll repay this favor somehow later...

If you're grateful, you can pay me back with your bodies.
Thanks to what happened, I got worked up like crazy without getting any release myself.

Anyway, we managed to escape somehow, but...
what do we do now?

...The Corrupting Power gathered in the pavilion is far too strong.
We cannot win by simply fighting head-on.
Unless we do something about the amassed Corrupting Power first...
If even you're saying that, a frontal assault is pointless.

Then do we need reinforcements? What about the other clans...
or the Church of Harmonix girls? They must have some experience dealing with Aberrant Spirits, right?
...It's too late.
Too late?

Yes. Like I said earlier, everyone's perception has been altered.
Even though this is the only area that's been corrupted...

Other people won't be able to recognize that anything is 'wrong' anymore.
Because their perception has been overwritten that way.

So...
that means we can't even call for backup.
Even if we told them, they wouldn't understand.

Then are we supposed to just stand by and watch?
Does anyone have a good idea?

I... wanted to let the children have a taste.
Of this day, this festival, this life and light...
Yes... To give the children a taste of that 'revelry' you speak of...
...Must we truly resort to fighting?
What?
Aberrant Spirits corrupt and taint this world.
Whether they want to or not, whether they intend to or not...

There is no place for them here.
And keeping the two separated...
is my duty as the Shrine Maiden of the Boundary.
Of course, I do not doubt that.

However...
I cannot help but wonder if there might be another way.
Don't tell me you're gonna ask me to figure something out again?

Hehe.
Did you see right through me?

You guys just keep dumping bigger and bigger headaches on me.
Are you sure you didn't get possessed by a sly fox spirit or something?

Ah!♡ But my friend,
you are the only one I can ask for such a favor.
My friend, and Kouchou.

Striking down an enemy...
is simpler than one might think.
However... For the sake of true grace and revelry, I would much prefer we take the more difficult path.
That just sounds like you're telling me to do all the hard work.
Hehe, is that how it sounded to you?

You are quite right. I have high hopes, you see.
That you, my friend... will resolve this matter for us.
After all, you are the best Fixer there is.

Tch...
When you put it like that, it's kinda hard to say no.

Ahh... Fixer...
I finally found you...♡

Oh, Chise, Kage!
Great timing. If you two lend us a hand...

I am afraid that will not be possible.
Because we are here... to arrest you.
Arrest me?!

Yes.
On charges including destruction of festival property, dining and dashing, assaulting pedestrians, and disturbing the peace.

Whoa, I didn't do any of that.
Dan Xi did.

My friend?!
Are you abandoning me right now?!

I'm the kind of guy who can toss aside a companion like yesterday's trash if I have to.
Don't worry, I'll make sure to send plenty of prison food and booze your way.

Why, you little—!
I take back what I just said about you being the Best Fixer!

Anyway, I really didn't do any of that stuff, right?
So that makes me innocent, doesn't it?
No.
Why?!
For the crime of being a bystander.

Just as I thought...
Both of them are under the influence of the Aberrant Spirits.
To the two of them, we probably look like people trying to ruin the festival.

Hehe... Enjoying the festival with you, Fixer... Just the two of us...
Let us spend a passionate festival night together...♡
I don't think that's what's going on with one of them right now.
Hey, Kage. Putting the charges aside, I told you to protect the festival before I left, so why are you acting like this? What happened to all those plans you're always making?
...Of course, I drew up a thorough plan just as you asked.
And I discovered the single biggest factor disrupting that perfect plan.
It's you, <:player>! You're the culprit!
What? How did you come to that conclusion?

Heh, in a way, she speaks the truth.
Since I brought you here, my friend, their festival is about to be disrupted.
Look, are they not positively furious?

Their common sense has been altered by the Aberrant Spirits.
At this rate, we might have to fight not just the Aberrant Spirits, but the people of Quartet as well...
I'll purify the Aberrant Spirits first.

The purification...
isn't working?

Just when I thought we'd barely escaped one crisis, here comes another.
What's the problem?
My power sends them back beyond the boundary.

But because this place has become their territory...
dividing the boundary has lost all meaning.

If it were just an aura like earlier, maybe...
but now that they have physical forms, I can't drive them out with my power.
...Then do we have no choice but to fight?
Hmm... Setting aside the sheer number of Aberrant Spirits, facing Chise head-on would not be a wise choice.

A warrior of the Moonshadow Wardens...
If we were to fight her in earnest, there would surely be grave collateral damage.
Hmm...

Hey.
Do you remember what Shade said at the pavilion?
What words do you mean?

She told us to go enjoy the festival to the fullest and come back.
Don't you think that's a little strange?
If she just wanted to get rid of us, she could've finished us off right there, or blasted us outside altogether.

Are you quite finished talking?
I regret to inform you that your every move is already within my calculations.
Now, come quietly and let me bind you!
WAIT A SECOND!!!

10111060.t:
W-What is it, <:player>?
If you have anything left to say in your defense, I'll hear you out.
No, it's just...
If we're going to fight anyway, how about we do it a little differently?
A different...
Way?

What exactly...
are you proposing we do here?

What else?
A 'match'.

A match?
I am here to arrest you, not to have a match...

The supreme art of war is to subdue the enemy without fighting.
Haven't you heard that before?

I promise.
If you beat me in a match, I won't resist, and I'll let you take me in without a word.

You will quietly...
come along with us...?

Yeah.
I won't even run away.

Ah...
That sounds lovely...♡

Wait, Lady Chise.
You can't seriously be falling for that...

Or we can just fight.
Though I doubt turning the festival streets into a chaotic battlefield is part of your plan, is it?

Heh.
Either way suits me just fine.
Ugh...
(If I coax her a little more, I think she'll fall for it again...)

Gah?!
I almost fell for it again!?
Hmph, I am sorry to disappoint you, but I will not fall for that trick anymore!
You intend to sweet-talk me like that and challenge me to something that gives you the advantage, don't you?

Someone tipped you off!?
Hey, that's cheating!

Fixer...
Surely you are not saying this just to run away, are you...?

I told you, I'm not.
I really mean it when I say I'll let you take me in without a word if you win.

If you're suspicious, you guys can pick the game.
Pick something you're confident in.
Do you mean that? Is it truly alright for us to choose something we are confident in?

Of course.
Who do you think I am?

Heh...
You made a promise, Fixer.

Very well.
In that case...

I shall make a special exception and accept your proposal this time.
However, the event will be...

A subject from the Intermediate Kunoichi Exam...
'Find the Hidden Kunoichi'!!
Find the...
Hidden Kunoichi?
